authorityPolicy: Locked SSOT and approved CR-001 text only; conflicting/quarantined branches are excluded and missing business behavior is never inferred.

gates.subject: Customer Segment taxonomy, source authority, ownership, and effective dating
findings: Step 10 B-031 recognizes multi-select Formwork and Loose Boards segments and future configurability/history.
No locked source defines assignment ownership, import/mapping authority, canonical codes, or effective membership mutation rules.
The existing account category and pricing customer_segment fields are not interchangeable with canonical customer membership.
gates.requiredDecision: Approve the canonical segment reference codes, assignment/import authority, who may change membership, effective dating rules, and historical reclassification behavior.

decision.dateBasis: imported_at within the selected semantic window
decision.ranking: descending summed value, then stable canonical key
decision.presentation: first 5, then More reveals the remaining authorized server-ranked result

gates.subject: Quotation Submitted and Under Negotiation transition graph
findings: Current locked quotation states and Step 8 workflow do not contain the requested exact transition graph.
Older branches contain conflicting states and cannot be used as authority.
SENT immutability, no formal revisions, supersedes_quotation_id, and no Cancel remain locked.
gates.requiredDecision: Approve exact transitions, actors, approval relation, prerequisites, retries, ETag/idempotency behavior, and treatment of APPROVED versus quotation status.

gates.subject: Shipment aggregate and milestone workflow
findings: CR-001 supplies milestone labels and minimum context but not aggregate cardinality, actors, evidence, amendments, backdating, or transition guards.
Pre-final shipment/POD/internal-order models conflict with the locked baseline and are not authority.
No Dispatch, Delivery confirmation, POD, carrier integration, or internal ERP order lifecycle is authorized.
gates.requiredDecision: Approve shipment identity/cardinality, ERP relation, milestone actors/guards/evidence, date correction/backdating, amendment rules, permissions, and audit contract.

gates.subject: Standalone Complaints Management

decision.ownershipBoundary: case access only; never widens Customer 360
decision.history: append-only complaint events and structured audit

authority: Step 7 BAK-066 and final complaint API catalog

gates.subject: External client identity
findings: No authoritative external-client identity, invitation, provisioning, customer binding, MFA/session, revocation, recovery, or support model exists in locked Steps 2-10.
gates.requiredDecision: Approve the external identity lifecycle and customer-binding authority before any portal account, route, API, or permission is created.

gates.subject: Client Portal permissions and projections
findings: No locked portal projection defines permitted order fields, shipment fields, complaint ownership, documents, downloads, exports, or attachments.
Internal Sales authorization cannot be reused as an external-client grant.
gates.requiredDecision: Approve server-side tenant/customer isolation and the exact list/detail/action projections for orders, shipments, complaints, documents, export, and attachments.

gates.subject: R&D datasets and read-only projection
findings: No authoritative R&D role, Most Requested Sizes definition, source measure, minimum cohort, field projection, drilldown, export, audit, or retention contract exists in locked Steps 2-10.
gates.requiredDecision: Approve the exact datasets/measures and privacy-safe read-only projection; pricing, cost, margin, finance, writes, approvals, and commercial administration stay denied.

gates.subject: Local/Global historical and effective-dating semantics
gates.requiredDecision: Approve the effective date and whether historical dashboards reclassify using the current rule or retain a dated/snapshotted classification.

decisions.CR001-DG-01: Admin-configurable canonical Customer Segment definitions and effective-dated account assignments; existing account-edit authority may assign; unknown import code creates DQ and never auto-creates a segment.
decisions.CR001-DG-04: Quotation document state DRAFT/SENT is independent from commercial state NOT_SUBMITTED/SUBMITTED/UNDER_NEGOTIATION; official send atomically sets SENT and SUBMITTED; SENT content is immutable; material change creates a new DRAFT with supersedes_quotation_id; Cancel stays out of V1.
decisions.CR001-DG-05: A Shipment belongs to exactly one imported ERP order and an order may have many shipments; Logistics owns append-only milestone and correction writes; Sales gets a read-only projection; no Dispatch/Delivery/POD/GPS/customs execution.
decisions.CR001-DG-07: Entra External ID/CIAM with MFA and BFF sessions only; no local password, self-registration, or social identity; customer bindings are explicit, multi-customer, auditable, and immediately revocable.
decisions.CR001-DG-08: The Client Portal exposes only explicitly bound customer order quantity/status, shipment milestone, and complaint projections; quotations, prices, Finance, contacts, exports, and unrestricted downloads are denied.
decisions.CR001-DG-09: R&D receives country-scoped, read-only Most Requested Sizes based only on official customer-facing quotation lines, with requested quantity and distinct quotation count separated; customer identity, pricing, Finance, writes, and exports are omitted/denied.
decisions.CR001-DG-10: Versioned Local/Global classification is effective from 2026-08-25 Africa/Cairo: EG/LY/SA/AE Local, other known countries Global, missing country Unclassified; historical reporting uses the rule valid as-of and classification never grants access.
